crossRefs.note: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea; Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians; Gaius of Derbe…
But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
Be diligent to come to me soon,
Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

people.name: Artemas
people.line: Companion of Paul, potential replacement for Titus

people.name: Nicopolis
people.line: A city in Epirus where Paul planned to winter

people.name: Tychicus
people.line: Faithful companion and messenger of Paul

translations.web: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
translations.bsb: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
translations.kjv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
translations.asv: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.
